notes: Data for plan.py and run_state.py. Phase membership and the listing order inside each phase follow the spec for audit-application exactly. 'wave' orders execution inside a phase: skills in the same wave are independent and may run in parallel; a later wave waits because it optionally reads an earlier wave's output (see references/child-contracts.md). Sequential runs use the same order. 'actions' are infrastructure steps run by an atomic skill (no status file, no report row, never counted as a skill run); an action with 'needed_by' is planned only when one of those skills is planned.

steps.text: run audit-stack-detection once ($AUDIT_CORE_ROOT/skills/audit-stack-detection/scripts/detect_stack.py) -> audit/stack.json (children read it instead of re-detecting)
ask: is the application multi-tenant? (recorded in audit/stack.json multi_tenant)
confirm per-stack prerequisites from references/<stack>.md (SDKs installed, build possible, DB/test URL access)
create audit/findings, audit/evidence, audit/status (and audit/reports, which every child writes)
ask: scope profile (full, security-only, pre-launch, compliance-only, custom)

actions.text: run audit-endpoint-inventory once ($AUDIT_CORE_ROOT/skills/audit-endpoint-inventory/scripts/inventory_endpoints.py -> audit/evidence/audit-endpoint-inventory/endpoints.json) for the skills that read it

roll up findings with audit-findings-rollup: de-duplicate by root_cause_key across skills, severity counts, go/no-go ($AUDIT_CORE_ROOT/skills/audit-findings-rollup/scripts/findings_rollup.py rollup -> audit/evidence/audit-findings-rollup/rollup.json)

audit-finding-writer.note: Not a pipeline step. Every child uses its format and scripts to emit findings; --skill refuses it.

audit-stack-detection.note: Infrastructure, not an audit area: runs once at setup and writes audit/stack.json. No findings, no status file, no report row; --skill refuses it.

audit-endpoint-inventory.note: Infrastructure, not an audit area: the discovery step writes audit/evidence/audit-endpoint-inventory/ for the skills that read it. No findings, no status file, no report row; --skill refuses it.

audit-findings-rollup.note: Infrastructure, not an audit area: the reporting step writes audit/evidence/audit-findings-rollup/ (de-duplication, counts, go/no-go). No findings, no status file, no report row; --skill refuses it.

audit-code-scan.note: Library used inside child skills (grep pass and shared file walker). Not a plan step; --skill refuses it.

audit-sensitive-data-catalog.note: Library used inside child skills (sensitive names and values). Not a plan step; --skill refuses it.

audit-git-history.note: Library used inside child skills (churn, blame, history scans). Not a plan step; --skill refuses it.

multi-tenant.why_default: Running audit-multi-tenant-isolation on a single-tenant app costs one short run that records the tenancy model; skipping it on a multi-tenant app hides the highest-impact class of leak.

critical-flows.default_non_interactive: top 3-5 candidate flows from audit-business-logic/scripts/flow_inventory.py, ranked by status writes

full.description: Every phase and every audit skill (multi-tenant isolation only when the app is multi-tenant).

security-only.description: The eight security skills, then reporting.

pre-launch.description: authz, multi-tenant isolation, secrets, injection, XSS, business-logic, datetime, concurrency, performance, readiness, dependencies - then reporting.

compliance-only.description: privacy mapper, GDPR, SOC 2, licensing - then reporting.

custom.description: A user-supplied list (--skills a,b,c; the audit- prefix is optional). Each skill is placed in its own phase and wave; reporting is appended.
